title: Woman 84 fell at night, can't get up, leg turned out

transcript.speaker: caller

transcript.speaker: operator

transcript.text: Yes, maybe seven hours. She's very cold and she has wet herself.

transcript.text: She has a bump on the forehead. She's a bit slow but she knows where she is.

transcript.speaker: caller
